caseNameFull: Crane-Johnson Co. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. John E. Hughes for petitioner. Solicitor General Jackson, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key and Lee A. Jackson for respondent. By special leave of Court, briefs of amid curiae were filed by Mr. H. H. Hoppe on behalf of Warren Telephone Co. et al., and by Messrs. Harry O. Glosser, Robert L. Judd, and W. S. Greathouse, on behalf of several corporate taxpayers, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.
